session.question: How do energy resourses and renewable energy in mining together help with environmental sustainability and sustainable development, and what good effects are said about using renewable energy in mining for sustainability?
session.answer:
Energy resources and renewable energy affect environmental sustainability in complementary ways. In the E-7 economies, renewable energy resources are associated with lower CO2 emissions across all quantiles, indicating a direct contribution to environmental sustainability, while nonrenewable energy resources and rapid economic growth are linked to higher environmental pressure. The study explicitly connects these findings to the UN Sustainable Development Goals, especially SDG 7, SDG 11/12, and SDG 13. (ali2023howdoenergy chunk 1)

In mining, integrating renewable energy helps reduce dependence on fossil fuels, which is important because mines are often located far from urban energy infrastructure. Renewable energy adoption in mining is presented as a strategic way to support sustainable development by lowering operating costs, reducing environmental pollution, creating new jobs, increasing knowledge in mining regions, and supporting a circular economy. These effects are described as improving sustainability indicators. (pouresmaieli2023integrationofrenewable chunk 1)

The literature on green mining further shows that combining renewable energy with electric vehicles and other green technologies reduces greenhouse gas emissions, lowers energy consumption, improves waste management, and decreases carbon emissions at monitored sites. This strengthens environmental sustainability and can also improve economic efficiency, particularly when supported by regulation and technological integration. (onifade2024advancingtowardsustainability chunk 1)

Overall, the evidence indicates that renewable energy in mining contributes to both environmental sustainability and broader sustainable development through emission reduction, efficiency gains, and positive socioeconomic effects. (pouresmaieli2023integrationofrenewable chunk 1, onifade2024advancingtowardsustainability chunk 1, ali2023howdoenergy chunk 1)

session.context:
pqac-9783944d: The excerpt says mining is highly dependent on fossil fuels because mines are often far from urban areas, so integrating renewable energy is presented as an effective way to reduce this reliance. The study examines how renewable energy in mining supports Sustainable Development Goals and uses SWOT analysis for strategic planning. It reports that renewable energy use in mining can create new jobs, reduce environmental pollution, increase knowledge in mining areas, support a circular economy, and lower operating costs. These effects are described as positively influencing sustainability indicators. The paper also notes challenges such as high investment, lack of skilled labor, maintenance costs, and limited awareness among mine owners.
From Mahdi Pouresmaieli, Mohammad Ataei, Ali Nouri Qarahasanlou, and Abbas Barabadi. Integration of renewable energy and sustainable development with strategic planning in the mining industry. Results in Engineering, 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rineng.2023.101412, doi:10.1016/j.rineng.2023.101412.

pqac-ac81bfe7: The excerpt reports that integrating renewable energy into mining can support sustainable development and environmental sustainability by reducing environmental pollution, lowering dependence on fossil fuels, creating new jobs, increasing knowledge in mining, fostering a circular economy, and reducing mining operating costs. These effects are described as positively influencing sustainable development indicators. The paper also notes that, in SWOT analysis, strengths and opportunities of renewable energy in mining outweigh weaknesses and threats, supporting an aggressive strategy for adoption.
From Mahdi Pouresmaieli, Mohammad Ataei, Ali Nouri Qarahasanlou, and Abbas Barabadi. Integration of renewable energy and sustainable development with strategic planning in the mining industry. Results in Engineering, 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rineng.2023.101412, doi:10.1016/j.rineng.2023.101412.

pqac-f69cc50f: The excerpt reports that integrating green mining technologies, including renewable energy sources and electric vehicles, reduces greenhouse gas emissions, lowers energy consumption, and improves waste management compared with traditional mining methods. It also states that these practices decrease carbon emissions and overall energy use at monitored sites, supporting a more sustainable mining model. The study concludes that renewable-energy-backed green mining enhances environmental sustainability and can also improve economic efficiency, especially when paired with strong regulatory frameworks and technological integration.
From Moshood Onifade, T. Zvarivadza, John Adebisi, Khadija Omar Said, Oluwatobi Dayo-Olupona, Abiodun Ismail Lawal, and Manoj Khandelwal. Advancing toward sustainability: the emergence of green mining technologies and practices. Green and Smart Mining Engineering, 2024. URL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gsme.2024.05.005, doi:10.1016/j.gsme.2024.05.005.

pqac-898cd00d: The excerpt discusses a study on how energy resources and financial development affect environmental sustainability in the E-7 economies from 2000–2020. It finds that high financial development, rapid economic growth, and fast-growing nonrenewable energy resources significantly impact environmental sustainability. In contrast, renewable energy resources are associated with negative coefficients for CO2 emissions across all quantiles (Q25 to Q95), suggesting they help reduce emissions and support environmental sustainability. The paper frames these results within the UN SDGs, especially SDG-7 (clean and affordable energy), SDG-11/12 (responsible consumption), and SDG-13 (climate action), and recommends policies aligned with sustainable development goals.
From Kishwar Ali, Jianguo Du, and Derviş Kırıkkaleli. How do energy resources and financial development cause environmental sustainability? Energy Reports, 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.egyr.2023.03.040, doi:10.1016/j.egyr.2023.03.040.

pqac-399c78bd: The excerpt says the paper evaluates green mining technologies aimed at reducing the environmental impact of traditional mining. It focuses on lowering energy consumption, greenhouse gas emissions, and chemical use. The study reports that integrating technologies such as electric vehicles and renewable energy sources in mining operations decreases carbon emissions and energy usage across studied sites, improving waste management compared with traditional methods. It concludes that green mining practices, supported by technology and regulation, enhance environmental sustainability and also improve economic efficiency. The paper recommends greater investment in green technologies and tighter regulation to promote wider adoption and optimization.
From Moshood Onifade, T. Zvarivadza, John Adebisi, Khadija Omar Said, Oluwatobi Dayo-Olupona, Abiodun Ismail Lawal, and Manoj Khandelwal. Advancing toward sustainability: the emergence of green mining technologies and practices. Green and Smart Mining Engineering, 2024. The paper frames renewable energy as potentially beneficial for sustainability, but also notes possible negative hidden impacts in production processes.

session.formatted_answer:
Question: How do energy resourses and renewable energy in mining together help with environmental sustainability and sustainable development, and what good effects are said about using renewable energy in mining for sustainability?

Energy resources and renewable energy affect environmental sustainability in complementary ways. In the E-7 economies, renewable energy resources are associated with lower CO2 emissions across all quantiles, indicating a direct contribution to environmental sustainability, while nonrenewable energy resources and rapid economic growth are linked to higher environmental pressure. The study explicitly connects these findings to the UN Sustainable Development Goals, especially SDG 7, SDG 11/12, and SDG 13. (ali2023howdoenergy chunk 1)

In mining, integrating renewable energy helps reduce dependence on fossil fuels, which is important because mines are often located far from urban energy infrastructure. Renewable energy adoption in mining is presented as a strategic way to support sustainable development by lowering operating costs, reducing environmental pollution, creating new jobs, increasing knowledge in mining regions, and supporting a circular economy. These effects are described as improving sustainability indicators. (pouresmaieli2023integrationofrenewable chunk 1)

The literature on green mining further shows that combining renewable energy with electric vehicles and other green technologies reduces greenhouse gas emissions, lowers energy consumption, improves waste management, and decreases carbon emissions at monitored sites. This strengthens environmental sustainability and can also improve economic efficiency, particularly when supported by regulation and technological integration. (onifade2024advancingtowardsustainability chunk 1)

Overall, the evidence indicates that renewable energy in mining contributes to both environmental sustainability and broader sustainable development through emission reduction, efficiency gains, and positive socioeconomic effects. (pouresmaieli2023integrationofrenewable chunk 1, onifade2024advancingtowardsustainability chunk 1, ali2023howdoenergy chunk 1)
